fullText.simplified:
七、酒后奇遇

    定海神针又粗又长，孙悟空想把它变小点儿。没想到它好像能听懂孙悟空的话一样，真的变小了！孙悟空拿在手里，美在心上。
    孙悟空竟然能改变定海神针的大小？龙王又吃惊又有些害怕。看到孙悟空这么喜欢定海神针，龙王知道定海神针要被孙悟空带走了。他想了想，只好说道：“既然你喜欢，就送给你吧。”
    孙悟空拿着金箍棒，越看越喜欢。他笑道：“感谢龙王的礼物，我很喜欢！等哪天有空，我再来找你玩！”说完，他翻身上了金斗云，带着金箍棒，飞回了花果山。
    花果山的猴子们看到大王手里的金箍棒，都兴奋地欢呼起来。孙悟空心里得意极了：从今天起，不管走到哪儿，我都要让人知道我孙悟空的大名！
    有了金箍棒以后，孙悟空的名气更大了。他每天带着猴子猴孙们在花果山练习功夫，附近的妖怪都离得远远的。还有很多妖怪经常给他送各种各样的礼物，想要跟孙悟空做朋友。
    这天，孙悟空和他的妖怪朋友们在水帘洞中喝酒。美酒是用山果做的，又香又甜。孙悟空一杯接一杯，喝得满脸通红，又高兴又得意。不知道喝了多少杯美酒，孙悟空在石床上睡着了。
    突然，冷风吹来。石床边出现了两个人，一个穿着白色的衣服，一个穿着黑色的衣服。孙悟空还没醒，被他们一拉就走了。他们拉着孙悟空走出花果山，来到了一条河边。河边有一条船，他们拉着孙悟空坐船过了河，然后来到了一个又冷又黑的地方。
    孙悟空一下子醒了，他吃惊地问道：“这是哪儿？你们是什么人？”
fullText.traditional:
七、酒後奇遇

    定海神針又粗又長，孫悟空想把它變小點兒。沒想到它好像能聽懂孫悟空的話一樣，真的變小了！孫悟空拿在手裡，美在心上。
    孫悟空竟然能改變定海神針的大小？龍王又吃驚又有些害怕。看到孫悟空這麼喜歡定海神針，龍王知道定海神針要被孫悟空帶走了。他想了想，只好說道：“既然你喜歡，就送給你吧。”
    孫悟空拿著金箍棒，越看越喜歡。他笑道：“感謝龍王的禮物，我很喜歡！等哪天有空，我再來找你玩！”說完，他翻身上了金斗云，帶著金箍棒，飛回了花果山。
    花果山的猴子們看到大王手裡的金箍棒，都興奮地歡呼起來。孫悟空心裡得意極了：從今天起，不管走到哪兒，我都要讓人知道我孫悟空的大名！
    有了金箍棒以後，孫悟空的名氣更大了。他每天帶著猴子猴孫們在花果山練習功夫，附近的妖怪都離得遠遠的。還有很多妖怪經常給他送各種各樣的禮物，想要跟孫悟空做朋友。
    這天，孫悟空和他的妖怪朋友們在水簾洞中喝酒。美酒是用山果做的，又香又甜。孫悟空一杯接一杯，喝得滿臉通紅，又高興又得意。不知道喝了多少杯美酒，孫悟空在石床上睡著了。
    突然，冷風吹來。石床邊出現了兩個人，一個穿著白色的衣服，一個穿著黑色的衣服。孫悟空還沒醒，被他們一拉就走了。他們拉著孫悟空走出花果山，來到了一條河邊。河邊有一條船，他們拉著孫悟空坐船過了河，然後來到了一個又冷又黑的地方。
    孫悟空一下子醒了，他吃驚地問道：“這是哪兒？你們是什麼人？”

sentences.english: The Sea-Calming Divine Needle was thick and long, and Sun Wukong wanted to make it smaller.

sentences.english: To his surprise, it seemed to understand Sun Wukong’s words and really did shrink!

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空拿在手里，美在心上。
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空拿在手裡，美在心上。
sentences.pinyin: sūn wù kōng ná zài shǒu lǐ měi zài xīn shang
sentences.english: Sun Wukong held it in his hand, delighted from the bottom of his heart.

sentences.traditional: 孫悟空竟然能改變定海神針的大小？龍王又吃驚又有些害怕。
sentences.pinyin: sūn wù kōng jìng rán néng gǎi biàn dìng hǎi shén zhēn de dà xiǎo lóng wáng yòu chī jīng yòu yǒu xiē hài pà
sentences.english: Sun Wukong could actually change the size of the Sea-Calming Divine Needle? The Dragon King was both astonished and a little afraid.

sentences.simplified: 看到孙悟空这么喜欢定海神针，龙王知道定海神针要被孙悟空带走了。
sentences.traditional: 看到孫悟空這麼喜歡定海神針，龍王知道定海神針要被孫悟空帶走了。
sentences.pinyin: kàn dào sūn wù kōng zhè me xǐ huan dìng hǎi shén zhēn lóng wáng zhī dào dìng hǎi shén zhēn yào bèi sūn wù kōng dài zǒu le
sentences.english: Seeing how much Sun Wukong liked the Sea-Calming Divine Needle, the Dragon King knew it would be taken away by Sun Wukong.

sentences.simplified: 他想了想，只好说道：“既然你喜欢，就送给你吧。”
sentences.traditional: 他想了想，只好說道：“既然你喜歡，就送給你吧。”

sentences.english: He thought for a moment and could only say, “Since you like it, I’ll give it to you.”

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空拿着金箍棒，越看越喜欢。
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空拿著金箍棒，越看越喜歡。
sentences.pinyin: sūn wù kōng ná zhe jīn gū bàng yuè kàn yuè xǐ huan
sentences.english: Sun Wukong held the Golden Cudgel and the more he looked at it, the more he liked it.

sentences.simplified: 他笑道：“感谢龙王的礼物，我很喜欢！等哪天有空，我再来找你玩！”
sentences.traditional: 他笑道：“感謝龍王的禮物，我很喜歡！等哪天有空，我再來找你玩！”
sentences.pinyin: tā xiào dào gǎn xiè lóng wáng de lǐ wù wǒ hěn xǐ huan děng nǎ tiān yǒu kòng wǒ zài lái zhǎo nǐ wán
sentences.english: He said with a smile, “Thank you for the gift, Dragon King. I like it very much! When I have time, I'll come back to visit you!"

sentences.simplified: 说完，他翻身上了金斗云，带着金箍棒，飞回了花果山。
sentences.traditional: 說完，他翻身上了金斗云，帶著金箍棒，飛回了花果山。
sentences.pinyin: shuō wán tā fān shēn shàng le jīn dǒu yún dài zhe jīn gū bàng fēi huí le huā guǒ shān
sentences.english: With that, he flipped onto the Somersault Cloud, took the Golden Cudgel, and flew back to Mount Huaguo.

sentences.simplified: 花果山的猴子们看到大王手里的金箍棒，都兴奋地欢呼起来。
sentences.traditional: 花果山的猴子們看到大王手裡的金箍棒，都興奮地歡呼起來。
sentences.pinyin: huā guǒ shān de hóu zi men kàn dào dà wáng shǒu lǐ de jīn gū bàng dōu xīng fèn de huān hū qǐ lái
sentences.english: The monkeys at Mount Huaguo saw the Golden Cudgel in the hands of the great king, and they all cheered excitedly.

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空心里得意极了：从今天起，不管走到哪儿，我都要让人知道我孙悟空的大名！
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空心裡得意極了：從今天起，不管走到哪兒，我都要讓人知道我孫悟空的大名！
sentences.pinyin: sūn wù kōng xīn lǐ dé yì jí le cóng jīn tiān qǐ bù guǎn zǒu dào nǎ'r wǒ dōu yào ràng rén zhī dào wǒ sūn wù kōng de dà míng
sentences.english: Sun Wukong was extremely proud: From today on, wherever I go, I want everyone to know the great name of Sun Wukong!

sentences.simplified: 有了金箍棒以后，孙悟空的名气更大了。
sentences.traditional: 有了金箍棒以後，孫悟空的名氣更大了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu le jīn gū bàng yǐ hòu sūn wù kōng de míng qì gèng dà le
sentences.english: With the Golden Cudgel, Sun Wukong's fame grew even greater.

sentences.simplified: 他每天带着猴子猴孙们在花果山练习功夫，附近的妖怪都离得远远的。
sentences.traditional: 他每天帶著猴子猴孫們在花果山練習功夫，附近的妖怪都離得遠遠的。
sentences.pinyin: tā měi tiān dài zhe hóu zǐ hóu sūn men zài huā guǒ shān liàn xí gōng fu fù jìn de yāo guài dōu lí de yuǎn yuǎn de
sentences.english: Every day, he led the monkey brethren of Mount Huaguo in practicing martial arts, and the nearby demons stayed far away.

sentences.simplified: 还有很多妖怪经常给他送各种各样的礼物，想要跟孙悟空做朋友。
sentences.traditional: 還有很多妖怪經常給他送各種各樣的禮物，想要跟孫悟空做朋友。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu hěn duō yāo guài jīng cháng gěi tā sòng gè zhǒng gè yàng de lǐ wù xiǎng yào gēn sūn wù kōng zuò péng you
sentences.english: There were many demons who brought Sun Wukong various gifts, all wanting to be friends with him.

sentences.simplified: 这天，孙悟空和他的妖怪朋友们在水帘洞中喝酒。
sentences.traditional: 這天，孫悟空和他的妖怪朋友們在水簾洞中喝酒。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiān sūn wù kōng hé tā de yāo guài péng you men zài shuǐ lián dòng zhōng hē jiǔ
sentences.english: One day, Sun Wukong and his demon friends were drinking wine in the Water Curtain Cave.

sentences.simplified: 美酒是用山果做的，又香又甜。
sentences.traditional: 美酒是用山果做的，又香又甜。
sentences.pinyin: měi jiǔ shì yòng shān guǒ zuò de yòu xiāng yòu tián
sentences.english: The fine wine was made from mountain fruits and was both fragrant and sweet.

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空一杯接一杯，喝得满脸通红，又高兴又得意。
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空一杯接一杯，喝得滿臉通紅，又高興又得意。
sentences.pinyin: sūn wù kōng yì bēi jiē yì bēi hē de mǎn liǎn tōng hóng yòu gāo xìng yòu dé yì
sentences.english: Sun Wukong drank one cup after another until his face turned bright red, feeling both happy and proud.

sentences.simplified: 不知道喝了多少杯美酒，孙悟空在石床上睡着了。
sentences.traditional: 不知道喝了多少杯美酒，孫悟空在石床上睡著了。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào hē le duō shao bēi měi jiǔ sūn wù kōng zài shí chuáng shang shuì zháo le
sentences.english: No one knew how many cups of wine he had drunk, but Sun Wukong fell asleep on the stone bed.

sentences.simplified: 突然，冷风吹来。
sentences.traditional: 突然，冷風吹來。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán lěng fēng chuī lái
sentences.english: Suddenly, a cold wind blew.

sentences.simplified: 石床边出现了两个人，一个穿着白色的衣服，一个穿着黑色的衣服。
sentences.traditional: 石床邊出現了兩個人，一個穿著白色的衣服，一個穿著黑色的衣服。
sentences.pinyin: shí chuáng biān chū xiàn le liǎng ge rén yí ge chuān zhe bái sè de yī fu yí ge chuān zhe hēi sè de yī fu
sentences.english: Two people appeared beside the stone bed, one in white and the other in black.

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空还没醒，被他们一拉就走了。
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空還沒醒，被他們一拉就走了。
sentences.pinyin: sūn wù kōng hái méi xǐng bèi tā men yì lā jiù zǒu le
sentences.english: Sun Wukong had not yet woken up and was dragged away by the two people.

sentences.simplified: 他们拉着孙悟空走出花果山，来到了一条河边。
sentences.traditional: 他們拉著孫悟空走出花果山，來到了一條河邊。
sentences.pinyin: tā men lā zhe sūn wù kōng zǒu chū huā guǒ shān lái dào le yì tiáo hé biān
sentences.english: They took Sun Wukong out of Mount Huaguo and to the edge of a river.

sentences.simplified: 河边有一条船，他们拉着孙悟空坐船过了河，然后来到了一个又冷又黑的地方。
sentences.traditional: 河邊有一條船，他們拉著孫悟空坐船過了河，然後來到了一個又冷又黑的地方。
sentences.pinyin: hé biān yǒu yì tiáo chuán tā men lā zhe sūn wù kōng zuò chuán guò le hé rán hòu lái dào le yí ge yòu lěng yòu hēi de dì fang
sentences.english: There was a boat by the river. They took Sun Wukong across the river in the boat, arriving at a cold and dark place.

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空一下子醒了，他吃惊地问道：“这是哪儿？你们是什么人？”
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空一下子醒了，他吃驚地問道：“這是哪兒？你們是什麼人？”
sentences.pinyin: sūn wù kōng yí xià zi xǐng le tā chī jīng de wèn dào zhè shì nǎ'r nǐ men shì shén me rén
sentences.english: Sun Wukong suddenly woke up. He asked in surprise, "Where is this? Who are you people?”

sentence_translations: 7. A Strange Encounter After Drinking
The Sea-Calming Divine Needle was thick and long, and Sun Wukong wanted to make it smaller.
To his surprise, it seemed to understand Sun Wukong’s words and really did shrink!
Sun Wukong held it in his hand, delighted from the bottom of his heart.
Sun Wukong could actually change the size of the Sea-Calming Divine Needle? The Dragon King was both astonished and a little afraid.
Seeing how much Sun Wukong liked the Sea-Calming Divine Needle, the Dragon King knew it would be taken away by Sun Wukong.
He thought for a moment and could only say, “Since you like it, I’ll give it to you.”
Sun Wukong held the Golden Cudgel and the more he looked at it, the more he liked it.
He said with a smile, “Thank you for the gift, Dragon King. I like it very much! When I have time, I'll come back to visit you!"
With that, he flipped onto the Somersault Cloud, took the Golden Cudgel, and flew back to Mount Huaguo.
The monkeys at Mount Huaguo saw the Golden Cudgel in the hands of the great king, and they all cheered excitedly.
Sun Wukong was extremely proud: From today on, wherever I go, I want everyone to know the great name of Sun Wukong!
With the Golden Cudgel, Sun Wukong's fame grew even greater.
Every day, he led the monkey brethren of Mount Huaguo in practicing martial arts, and the nearby demons stayed far away.
There were many demons who brought Sun Wukong various gifts, all wanting to be friends with him.
One day, Sun Wukong and his demon friends were drinking wine in the Water Curtain Cave.
The fine wine was made from mountain fruits and was both fragrant and sweet.
Sun Wukong drank one cup after another until his face turned bright red, feeling both happy and proud.
No one knew how many cups of wine he had drunk, but Sun Wukong fell asleep on the stone bed.
Suddenly, a cold wind blew.
Two people appeared beside the stone bed, one in white and the other in black.
Sun Wukong had not yet woken up and was dragged away by the two people.
They took Sun Wukong out of Mount Huaguo and to the edge of a river.
There was a boat by the river. They took Sun Wukong across the river in the boat, arriving at a cold and dark place.
Sun Wukong suddenly woke up. He asked in surprise, "Where is this? Who are you people?”
